name: LedgerFile::save_atomic

test_list.description: Missing parent directories are created; the file holds the rendered ledger.
A save that cannot replace a locked ledger fails and the old content is intact (Windows).
A short-lived sharing violation on the destination is retried until it succeeds (Windows).
When the rename cannot happen, no temporary file remains.
save_if_unchanged fails with ConcurrentWrite when the file changed since it was read.
save_if_unchanged succeeds when the file is as read.
A leftover temp file from an earlier crash does not affect load or save.
Two threads updating one ledger lose no issue and leave a parseable file.

output_description: Ledger replaced atomically or old content left in place.
